rows.summary: Duplicate of R2-015, fixed in a15b045: usePanelResize reads the stored width in try/catch (blocked storage opens at 360 px) and lets go of the drag before a best-effort setItem (full storage no longer leaves the panel following the pointer). panel-resize-storage passes at HEAD (now driven by pointer events, see R2-144).

The editor header's rename box (useRename) opens on the name the résumé has at that moment, and leaving it writes nothing unless the name was changed: a rename made in another tab is never written back over. Same root cause as R2-084.
The page-wide ErrorBoundary takes the path as resetKey (AppRoutes → RouteFrame), so Back or any link away from a page that crashed shows the next page instead of 'Something went wrong'.

A new path reached by a link scrolls the window to the top (RouteFrame), so Privacy and Terms open at their start. Back/Forward leave the scroll to the browser, and a search-only change (?tab=) does not move it. The workspace pages keep their own <main> scroll memory (useScrollMemory).

The Terms and Privacy back arrow (useBackOrHome) goes to the dashboard when no app page is behind it (location.key 'default': a direct visit or a link from another site), otherwise back. The icon-only arrow is labelled 'Back'.

useEditorTab reads ?tab= from the router and validates it: an unknown value opens the Résumé tab and is removed from the address. Picking a tab replaces ?tab= (no history entry per click), so a reload reopens it.

Store saves are coalesced (coalescedWriter): a change after a quiet spell is written at once; later keystrokes are written together 300 ms after the last one, and at least every 2 s. pagehide, beforeunload, a hidden tab and unmount flush what is held. persistError reporting and recovery are unchanged. Other tabs' saves (even two in a row while a save is held, 544decb) are taken without undoing either tab's changes. 20 keystrokes now cost ≤2 whole-store writes instead of 20. Leaving the page between another tab's save and this tab's re-render writes the held save with that save taken in (d718ad6). The editor's save status reads "Saving…" while a write waits and "Saved …" only once storage holds it (13a0eb5).

Dashboard cards and the editor header share useRename: the draft is primed when the box opens, and onRename fires only for a changed, non-empty name that is neither the name the box opened on nor the current one. The store's renameResume ignores an unchanged name (no updatedAt, no save, no sync).

A failed Google sign-in shows a dismissable role=alert under the button that says what to do: allow pop-ups, this address is not set up for sign-in, no connection, blocked storage, too many tries, or 'Sign-in failed (code)'. The alert clears on the next try. Closing the popup (popup-closed-by-user, cancelled-popup-request, user-cancelled) shows nothing.

The split-view handle is a focusable role=separator with aria-orientation=vertical, aria-valuenow/min/max and a label. Arrow keys move it 16 px and Home/End go to 240/640. It drags with pointer events (mouse, pen or finger; pointercancel ends the drag), with touch-action: none and a wider hit area over the preview. Checked in real Chromium with touch, mouse and keyboard. The handle captures the pointer while dragged, and a lost capture ends the drag (40a2df8).

issues: R2-077 (Medium): at 27bc9d1, two saves from another tab while this tab held a save made the second one's edits undone and deletions come back (stored ref only advanced on this tab's writes)
R2-084 (Low): box opened, then renamed in another tab, then left untouched still wrote the old name back
R2-073: no test pinned that Back (POP) leaves the scroll alone
Fixed after review in d718ad6: a pagehide landing between another tab's storage event and the re-render wrote the stale held state.
Fixed after review in 13a0eb5: the editor's 'Saved' label could lead the actual write by up to ~2 s
Added after review in 40a2df8: the resize handle captures the pointer while dragged

baselineFailures: tests/playwright/parity-ui-controls.spec.mjs 'classic: Design panel' flags the Inter/Literata font buttons as inert. It fails the same way on the base build in this container (web fonts unreachable); the other 9 specs in the file pass.
notes: Existing tests whose harness (not assertions) changed: tests/unit/panel-resize-storage.unit.mjs and cypress/e2e/23-editor-panels.cy.js now drive the drag with pointer events (R2-144; Cypress not run here); tests/pdf/32-editor-tab-scroll.test.mjs gives its MemoryRouter the address it used to put on window.location.hash (R2-076); tests/pdf/16-saved-data-two-tabs.test.mjs reads storage after a pagehide, tests/pdf/16-saved-data-photo-size.test.mjs's until() also polls in real time, and tests/playwright/parity-ui-controls.spec.mjs's saved() dispatches pagehide (R2-077). Any future test that reads cpwtcv_v1 right after a second quick change must flush (pagehide) or wait ~300 ms. EditorHeader's `rename` prop now takes useRename's shape; usePanelResize returns separatorProps instead of onDragHandleMouseDown. R2-072 and R2-073 share one commit (ab44531) because both live in the new RouteFrame. Commit trailers use this session's URL (session_01S681bgs4qE2ric3C7MivaC).
